persona: Non-native English speaker; follows literal UI labels
blockedAt: Discover the collection → /shop: collection unavailable after one Retry

findings.title: Cannot reach a purchasable product
findings.actual: Collection stays temporarily unavailable; product and checkout journey cannot proceed.

findings.title: Shop says zero pieces when it cannot load the collection
findings.actual: 0 pieces to discover and collection temporarily unavailable present competing literal states. I read zero as nothing available to buy.
findings.expected: Say collection unavailable, and do not state a known inventory count until loaded.

findings.title: Bag error uses technical words and promises a saved bag
findings.actual: Your Bag (0 items), Failed to fetchRetry, and Your bag is safely saved appear together. I do not know what fetch means or whether this is an empty/saved/unavailable bag.
findings.expected: One clear unavailable state with a plain retry action; no unverified saved claim or zero item count.

Create an account link opens Full name, Email address, Password fields; password help says at least 12 characters. No real signup submitted.

limitations: Backend unavailable during baseline. No product, add-to-bag, checkout or purchase first success was achieved. No real signup or external message sent.
